messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool rpool-gpu-us-west-2 is at 98% utilization for 5m, queue growth detected, >10k requests queued, upstream 429 spikes. Paging oncall. runbook: /inc/rt-gpu-saturation
marc_oncall: Ack. I'm on it. grabbing metrics and checking autoscaler health.
eli_sre: I'm available. any customer-facing services impacted yet?
jordan_pm: Support reports multiple customer 429s for realtime endpoints since ~10:12 PDT. reported latency spikes and retries.
katie_support: Confirmed, 4 high-priority customers opened chats, one reporting timeouts on invoices feature. Sending them an interim note.
marc_oncall: Quick triage: checking autoscaler logs and scale limits.
marc_oncall: run: kubectl -n inference get hpa rpool-gpu-us-west-2 -o yaml
marc_oncall: logs show autoscaler attempted scale up but hit maxReplicas=4 -> current replicas=4, desired=10. autoscaler heartbeat is healthy.
eli_sre: That would explain queue growth. Why is maxReplicas capped? recent policy change?
anna_eng: @marc_oncall I pushed the new rate-tier policy yesterday afternoon; it included a conservative max for this pool while we validate cost controls. I thought it only applied to non-prod, but maybe the label selection matched prod.
marc_oncall: can you paste the policy?
anna_eng: ```
# rate-tier config
pools:
  - name: rpool-gpu-us-west-2
    tier: standard
    max_replicas: 4
    token_window: 60
    token_rate: 250
```
marc_oncall: oh. that max_replicas=4 is the culprit. we've been saturating at 4.
eli_sre: Also seeing throttling at the edge: token bucket is draining quickly and refill rate is low; lots of 429s emitted from proxy.
deploy-bot: AUTO: rollback flag not set. No recent deploys to rpool-gpu-us-west-2 in last 30m.
jordan_pm: Customer impact: 4 customers with increased error rates, one on slow retries. Need ETA and mitigation to update customer comms.
marc_oncall: Mitigation options: 1) raise pool max_replicas to 12 (fast config change), 2) temporarily relax token rate on proxy to reduce 429s, 3) enable fallback to cpu-quantized model for non-SLA traffic.
eli_sre: I can apply (1) now. Doing: infractl pool update rpool-gpu-us-west-2 --max-replicas=12
eli_sre: applied. Kubernetes shows new scale target, autoscaler will attempt to provision nodes.
marc_oncall: Also temporarily increasing token_rate to 1000 to smooth short-term bursts. Applying to edge config.
anna_eng: Be mindful of cost but agreed, do it.
katie_support: Sending update to affected customers: "We're investigating increased errors and are applying mitigations; next update in 10m."
marc_oncall: Checking cluster events: provisioning nodes, but provisioning time ~3-4m. queue still growing but growth rate slowing.
marc_oncall: Observability: tail of logs showing 429 endpoints: ```
2026-03-15T17:12:08Z proxy error 429 path=/v1/generate customer=acct-9abc tokens=1024
2026-03-15T17:12:09Z proxy drop 429 token_bucket=maxed refill=250/60s
```
eli_sre: After scaling triggers, new pods are coming up. core metrics: token bucket refill still low for some tiers due to mismapped tier labels - policy meant to target 'standard', some pods had label 'std' so they used default stricter limits.
marc_oncall: So two root causes: accidental conservative max_replicas and a label mismatch causing rate-tier misapply -> extra throttling.
jordan_pm: Good find. For customer comms: ETA for visible recovery?
eli_sre: New pods are ready. We should see successful fall in queue in 2-3 minutes as KV cache warms.
marc_oncall: queue started decreasing at 17:16. error rate dropping. I'll keep watching.
anna_eng: Postmortem actions I propose: 1) Guardrails on pool config changes (prevent defaulting prod to low max), 2) validation for tier label names in CI, 3) alert rule for autoscaler desired>maxReplicas mismatch, 4) doc on token window semantics.
katie_support: Customer follow-up: shared recovery notice, offered credit for impacted window, waiting on SRE confirm.
eli_sre: Confirmed recovery at 17:20. 429 rate returned to baseline, queue length normal.
marc_oncall: Escalation summary for postmortem: short blip of customer 429s for ~8 minutes, root causes: misconfigured pool cap + tier label mismatch -> misapplied throttling. Mitigations applied: increased max_replicas and raised token_rate, enabled cpu-fallback config for low-tier traffic.
jordan_pm: Thanks team. I'll draft customer-facing postmortem and coordinate with eng for rollout of guardrails.
marc_oncall: handoff to next oncall @eli_sre for follow-ups. I'll remain available for questions.
eli_sre: Taking handoff. I'll open incident summary + links to diffs and runbook run.
marc_oncall: Closing live thread. @katie_support please update customers with final window and mitigation steps. :thumbsup:
katie_support: will do. sending final note now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: 3400123456 resolved - severity: Sev2 - duration: 00:08:33 - summary: GPU pool saturation due to config cap + tier mislabel -> 429 spikes. Followups: guardrails, CI validation, alert rule.
